mission_03: Image data augmentation is essential for training robust computer vision models. Common augmentations include horizontal/vertical flips, rotations, brightness/contrast adjustments, zooming, and cropping. These transformations create diverse training examples that help models generalize to real-world variations. In this mission, you will implement basic image augmentations using NumPy operations on simulated 28x28 grayscale images. You will learn how np.fliplr() performs horizontal flips, np.rot90() handles rotation, and scalar multiplication adjusts brightness. These fundamental operations form the basis of more sophisticated augmentation pipelines.
